title: The brass star theatre
alt: An elaborate brass armillary sphere stands at the centre of a burgundy Art Deco theatre.
description: A symmetrical architectural scene joins warm metal, velvet seating and a constellation ceiling.
prompt: A sumptuous original Art Deco theatre interior seen from a central aisle. Deep-burgundy velvet seats fill curved rows on both sides of a broad stepped aisle, which reaches an elevated display holding one elaborate brass armillary sphere. Concentric gold rings surround a small central globe, with clear physical supports and a stable circular stand. Illuminated abstract star lines decorate the dark domed ceiling. Brass handrails follow the stairs and ribbed wall lights cast warm accents. Coherent architecture, rich fabric and brushed metal, no audience or readable text.
